app.name: Bina
app.tagline: Count and classify urban signs from street-level imagery

home.heading: Choose an area on the map
home.help: Hold Shift and drag across the map to set the survey box.
home.tooLarge: That area is larger than the limit. Draw a smaller box.

job.failedNote: {count} signs could not be classified and are counted as unknown
job.noImagery: No street-level imagery in this area. That means no coverage, not no signs.

filter.hint: Click to show or hide. Double-click for this class only

list.searchPlaceholder: Search sign name or image id
list.emptyHint: Adjust the filters or clear the search.

detail.needsReview: The model is unsure about this one; it is queued for labeling.
detail.evidenceHelp: This sign was cropped from the street-level image below and classified by the model named here. Mapillary's own category is independent evidence you can check our class against.
detail.openSource: View the source image on Mapillary
detail.noCrop: No image was stored for this sign

label.title: Labeling
label.question: What type of sign is this?
label.emptyHint: Every low-confidence sign has been checked.
label.hint: Least confident signs are shown first.

surveys.title: Surveys
surveys.emptyBody: Pick a street in the panel beside this to start scanning it.

compose.title: New survey
compose.subtitle: Choose a street to count the signs along it.
compose.noHits: No street found with that name.
compose.bufferHelp: How far from the centreline a sign still counts as belonging to this street. Widen it for dual carriageways.
